verbalization: The visible evidence suggests that Abiesadine J may interact with the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter through multiple pathways. Path_385877 indicates that Abiesadine J targets Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(I)/G(S)/G(O) subunit gamma-2, which in turn is targeted by a complex compound, and this compound further targets the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter. Path_385878 shows that Abiesadine J targets WRL68, which is targeted by (24S)-24,25-Dihydroxysunpollenol, which also targets the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter. These findings collectively suggest that Abiesadine J may exert its effects through a series of molecular interactions that ultimately lead to the modulation of the Sodium/bile acid cotransporter. The evidence is consistent with a mechanism involving protein targets that are involved in bile acid transport, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
